before_taxonomy.classification_basis: Fabricated quotations and a nonexistent source title were propagated into professional news copy below the assurance threshold required for publication and syndication. The article falsely attributed invented words and a nonexistent professional title to identifiable Telenor sources. Direct quotations and source identity required verification before publication, yet five invented quotations and a nonexistent title passed into the published article. NTB's correction identified the external AI writing tool as the source of the fabricated quotations and nonexistent title, supporting the attributed mechanism through its internal review.
